name: Karina Andersen
title: Founder
bio:
Karina Andersen is the founder of SmilingOne and the Circles of Change™ Academy, and a social impact change specialist working across prisons, boardrooms and classrooms.
For two decades, she has guided leaders and communities through deep transformation in South Africa, blending intuitive leadership coaching, culture change and human development to unlock potential and shift systems from the inside out.
Her approach was not learned from a manual, but shaped through breaking her own harmful cycles alongside others breaking theirs.
She is the author of The Responsible Individual (2008) and 10 Leadership Lessons: From Prisons to Boardrooms (2022), with more books in progress.
Her life’s work is putting the heart back into leadership and inspiring a shift from ME to WE.
